column1: # Applied ONLY when GOZJARO_SOURCE_MIRROR=ustc (see config/lfs.env). The longest
# matching origin prefix wins; anything unmatched is served straight from
# upstream. The downloader always falls back to the upstream URL if the mirror
# 404s / fails, so a wrong entry can never break a build — it just misses the
# NOTE (verify from your own network): these prefixes follow USTC's public
# mirror host layout. USTC blocks datacenter egress IPs, so the bytes can't be
# confirmed here — spot-check a couple with `curl -I` from inside China and
# the fallback will cover the rest.
# GNU (ftpmirror + ftp.gnu both map into USTC's /gnu tree, incl. glibc/gcc subfolders)
# Debian source pool (expect / procps / psmisc .orig tarballs)
# GitHub (release assets + repo archives). Preserves the path tail.
